content: {"like":["Outstanding performance by Lisa Ortiz as Deedlit, praised as the best thing about the dub","Solid voice work from John Knox, Greg Wolfe, Simone Grant, Bruce Winant, Al Muscari, Chris Yates, Karen Smith, and Dick Rodstein","Bill Timoney’s dual role as voice director and Parn delivering energy and passion","Lisa DeSimone’s English opening and ending songs with a lovely voice","Overall dub quality considered decent for a 1990s production, better than many contemporaries","Positive reception from producers, especially regarding Lisa Ortiz’s performance"],"dislike":["Inconsistent lipsync, sometimes lines don’t match mouths","Some moments of iffy delivery and dialogue","Minor characters could be better, some incidental voices less strong","Ted Lewis’s performance as priest Etoh seen as weak link with high‑pitched voice","Primitive feel compared to modern dubbing","One instance where King Fahn’s voice is heard while Kashue’s mouth moves"]}
